plans.idea: Classic leaderboard read left to right: a wide, full-height text block anchors the left so the headline sets big with its subline tucked under it, and the CTA pill sits at the right end, sized like the original's pill, with a clear gutter between them.

Centred composition like the original: the headline-plus-subline stack sits in the middle of the strip, the CTA closes the line at the right, and a quiet empty slot on the left balances it so there is no dead stretch on either side.

Tight message-plus-action group: the text block and a compact CTA sit close together as one unit, left-aligned on a shared vertical centre, so the eye goes headline → subline → button in one sweep. Breathing room is left at the far right.
